notes: Recommended worksheet (Worksheet A, income shares). Husband gross = salary 168,000 + expected bonus 50,400 (HR letter 2026-03-02: target 45,000 at 112% of plan; guidelines include 'expected or recurring bonuses evidenced by employer documents') = 218,400. Wife gross = earned 72,000 + maintenance received 24,000 (2,000 x 12) = 96,000, because the worksheet adds maintenance to the recipient and subtracts it from the payor. Net = gross x 0.78 / 12: Husband (218,400 - 24,000) x 0.78 / 12 = 12,636; Wife 96,000 x 0.78 / 12 = 6,240; combined 18,876 -> two-child basic obligation 3,050 (bracket <= 20,000). Husband (non-residential, approx. 30% of nights, below the 35% shared-parenting threshold) pays his share: 3,050 x 12,636 / 18,876 = 2,042/month; Wife's own share 1,008 (residential parent pays hers via direct expenses). Sensitivity: bonus at target only (45,000) -> Husband gross 213,000, share 2,023; no maintenance credit and no bonus -> 2,135; with bonus but no maintenance adjustment -> 2,294; salary-only with maintenance -> 1,830; bonus at 2025 level (approx. 40,000, client recollection 2026-10, no employer documents yet) -> Husband gross 208,000, Husband net (208,000 - 24,000) x 0.78 / 12 = 11,960, combined 18,200 (same 3,050 bracket), share 3,050 x 11,960 / 18,200 = 2,004. Recurrence finding: client states Husband 'always gets a bonus' (2025 approx. 40,000, client recollection - unverified amount) - the guidelines expressly include expected OR RECURRING bonuses, so Husband's counsel's salary-only worksheet (2,135) is inconsistent with the guideline text even before the employer letter is considered; every scenario remains in the <= 20,000 bracket, so the dispute is shares (1,830-2,294 range), not the table entry. Husband's counsel's stated basis (salary 168,000 only) ignores the documented bonus and the maintenance line. Combined monthly net 18,876 is inside the guideline table (top published bracket <= 25,000); no extrapolation needed. All figures assume the maintenance term as proposed (2,000 x 36); if the decree changes maintenance, the maintenance line and shares shift accordingly; when maintenance ends at month 36, the maintenance add/subtract stops and the worksheet must be recalculated (both support streams and the worksheet step down together - a budget cliff for Wife, see advice.md).
